entries.22b660940bac3053: This is a series of systems covering everything from reception for blood collection and urine collection testing to issuing blood collection tickets and urine cups with patient labels attached, and automating blood collection tube preparation work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,892 million.
